items.question: How are images converted into PDF without a backend?
items.answer: This tool uses the pdf-lib library running natively in your browser. Each uploaded image is scaled and embedded onto document pages according to your layout preferences.

items.question: What page sizes and orientations can I choose?
items.answer: Standard A4 (595.28 x 841.89 pt), US Letter (612 x 792 pt), and Fit-to-Image modes are supported in Portrait, Landscape, or Auto orientation.

items.question: Can I change the order of pages before downloading?
items.answer: Yes. You can use the Move Up and Move Down controls on each image to arrange pages exactly as desired.

items.question: What margin and image scaling options are available?
items.answer: You can choose between zero margin, 18 pt (small), or 36 pt (standard), with options to Contain (preserve aspect ratio), Cover, or Stretch images across the page.

items.question: Is my document private and secure?
items.answer: Completely private. No image bytes or generated PDF documents ever leave your device or travel over the network.

items.question: Will my photos be stretched or distorted in the PDF?
items.answer: In the default Contain mode, the engine calculates uniform proportional scaling so images are centered without any aspect ratio distortion.

items.question: Are the created PDF documents compatible with all PDF readers?
items.answer: Yes. Generated documents conform strictly to the PDF 1.7 specification, rendering consistently across Adobe Acrobat, Apple Preview, Google Chrome, and mobile viewers.

items.question: Is there a limit on how many images can be compiled into one PDF?
items.answer: You can compile dozens of images simultaneously. Memory management ensures buffers are processed sequentially into the PDF binary structure.
